decisions.quote: The findings across direct and conceptual replication of Johnson et al. (2002) provide mixed support to the original study's assertion.
decisions.location: Results, Summary of findings of Johnson et al. (2002) across original, direct replication, and conceptual replication studies (line 102)
decisions.reason: While the direct replication in Part 2 failed to find a default effect, the conceptual replication in Extension 2 replicated the Opt-Out versus Opt-In default effect, and the authors explicitly conclude that the combined direct and conceptual replications provide mixed support for Johnson et al. (2002).
